question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Grumpy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Irritable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Grumpy"** refers to a mood or behavior characterized by irritability or a bad temper. (चिड़चिड़ा)
 
 
• **Example:** The old man was grumpy because his morning coffee was cold.
 
 
• **"Irritable"** means easily annoyed or angered, often showing signs of impatience or frustration. (चिड़चिड़ा)
 
 
• **Example:** She became irritable after working long hours without a break.
